summary: Re-assessment APPENDED to the 2026-07-20 baseline, which is largely obsolete: four of its headline claims were re-checked against code today and are FALSE — send_uar_service is gone from chat.rs, ensure_uar_lane_supported no longer requires a URL, the SDK runtime accessors return Arc<T> not Option, and the local provider IS registered. Planning from the 07-20 text would have re-done shipped, device-certified work. ONE real gap remains and it is exactly task 3.1: uar.rs:880 still builds the embedded runtime with InMemoryProvider, so agents, skills, policies, settings, memory, knowledge, conversations, run state and A2UI are lost on process death.
next: Re-verify all 14 tasks in openspec/changes/embed-uar-mobile-offline/tasks.md against code BEFORE planning — several describe work now visibly done, the same drift that left qwen35-local-tools unticked while device-certified. Then plan the InMemoryProvider -> SurrealDbProvider swap; note SurrealDbProvider::new is async and needs a storage path.
open_questions: Where does the mobile SurrealDB file live — the KnowMe instance already embedded for memory/graph-RAG, or a second store? Two instances in one mobile process is a resource decision.
What happens to existing in-memory state on upgrade? There is no RAM->disk migration; first launch after the swap starts empty.
Is desktop in scope for the same swap? It shares the embedded runtime path, so leaving it on InMemoryProvider splits behaviour across surfaces.
notReVerified: Airplane-mode certification (5.4, 5.5) and the dependency-profile/licensing risks still carry the 07-20 date.
